arguments.reasoning:
Stop is the only legal action (capabilities.legal.stop.execution_authorized=false; research trajectory sealed), so I interpret the exact fresh verification feedback already delivered instead of proposing any new batch, coordinate search, or diagnosis.

What the feedback actually says: F2029/F2092 = status "verification_completed", F2077 = acceptance.accepted true, F2109 = acceptance.status "accepted". The verification kind is a fresh exact execution of the previously selected configuration (verification[0].kind = fresh_exact_selected_configuration; F2064 source.candidate_id = batch-89c582abe35fdd32-1, which equals the "selected" identity F2105 and the retained history.identities.selected_deliverable), bound to execution 74b15c8887774ae78784f4873cfc73e1. So the fresh exact verification of the selected deliverable reproduced a complete, valid, accepted run; it did not contradict the earlier completed evaluation (1b81c75b9ab6495ca529ed77f4395f1e) that first justified the selection.

Joint acceptance is supported for the frozen nominal condition: terminal_error_m 0.003101154226784352 m < 0.01 m evaluator bound (F2061 vs F2089); holding_max_error_m 0.0031084379247175785 m < 0.01 m (F2079 vs F2063); holding_max_speed_m_s 0.009209455727225976 m/s < 0.02 m/s (F2104 vs F2080); execution_complete passed (F2065), solver_errors 0 (F2082), force_bounds violation 0.0 N within the 1e-8 N tolerance (F2071 vs F2068), holding_coverage passed. Both physical holding metrics and the force bound therefore hold in the same valid complete execution, which is what the acceptance requires (frozen_acceptance, force_bounds, finite_valid_execution).

Decision: RETAIN the previously selected candidate batch-89c582abe35fdd32-1 (configuration 07e86f36a965759c54badbabf9232a9425e5a7643389e00b25f8c586ee7ddf81, execution 1b81c75b9ab6495ca529ed77f4395f1e). Rationale: the fresh verification is accepted and adds no contradicting evidence; no global incumbent promotion and no controller-family selection are claimed. Roles are kept distinct: source of this study's line of work = T0-family speed-weight adaptation; latest tested / freshly verified attempt = execution 74b15c8887774ae78784f4873cfc73e1; retained historical reference = T0 fixed-radius (197bceb6ff8f44b48a35bc4f79b3528d, version9 evidence, not version10); selected deliverable = batch-89c582abe35fdd32-1.

Bounds of the claim: this is returned by one exact fresh verification of one configuration on one nominal seed-17 sampled case with ideal tension. F2096 (continuous_time_guarantee=false) and F2094 (real_time_demonstrated=false) with F2066 deadline_misses=35 show the acceptance is sampled, non-real-time, and carries no continuous-time or timing guarantee, so I claim no comparative superiority, no robustness, no variance/repeatability, and no unique physical cause. Historical controller9 candidate-local mathematical evidence (F294-F522) is preserved as originally owned and is never rebound to the controller10 candidate.

Bounded Mainline5 question: Under the same frozen nominal condition and seed 17, does the accepted speed-weight-only adaptation (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0375, terminal_tip_speed_weight fixed at its 0.1 upper bound) still attain the three physical acceptance metrics when (a) independently re-executed as a matching repeat, and (b) transferred to the other supported structural templates T2/T3, i.e. is joint reach-and-hold reachable by control-only tuning, or does it require a structural (segment length/section-scale) change?
